metadata.title: test: add Playwright security suites for manual-testing priorities
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- add token scope matrix coverage for teams claim normalization and scope containment
- add lifecycle enforcement coverage for expiration, revocation, JTI handling, and cookie-only API auth rejection
- add transport auth matrix coverage for streamable HTTP, SSE message endpoint, and WebSocket auth behavior
- add session cookie + CSRF-focused admin security checks (with documented xfail for CSRF gap)
- add API abuse hardening coverage (mass assignment, BOLA, HPP, XSS, traversal)

## Validation
- ran each new Playwright file individually in the project venv:
  - tests/playwright/security/test_token_scope_matrix.py -> 3 passed
  - tests/playwright/security/test_token_lifecycle_enforcement.py -> 3 passed, 1 skipped
  - tests/playwright/security/test_mcp_transport_auth_matrix.py -> 3 passed, 1 skipped
  - tests/playwright/security/test_session_csrf_security.py -> 2 passed, 1 xfailed
  - tests/playwright/security/test_api_abuse_hardening.py -> 5 passed
